checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One playable 15-second widescreen film with three sequential scenes
must.why: Single 16:9 clip, frames show progression from standing to seated to smiling.

must.item: Woman curly black bob + yellow raincoat; man white beard + blue coat
must.why: Both clearly match and stay consistent across frames.

must.item: Opening visibly establishes the bench is wet
must.why: Frame 1 shows only a sliver of bench; the wetness is barely visible, and a hand with newspaper is already in frame.

must.item: Man offers folded newspaper as dry seat, ending shows both seated and smiling
must.why: Newspaper is held open and read by the woman, not laid on the seat; the ending does show both seated and smiling.

must.item: Live-action appearance and no audible soundtrack
must.why: Photoreal look; silent was requested, and audio can't be heard from stills.

faults.what: Newspaper is used as reading material, not folded and laid on the wet seat; the story beat is lost.
Wet bench not established; the man is already sitting before the offer, and the newspaper appears in frame 1 before any scene setup.
Frame 3 shows the two seated stiffly and looking at each other with neutral expressions, so the story is muddled.
The woman's hands appear soft and slightly warped around the newspaper; low 480p resolution.

summary: The clip is a good-looking, live-action film with correct characters and a sweet ending smile, but it misses the wet-bench setup and the beat where he offers a folded newspaper to sit on.
